items.description: GuardDog is a CLI tool to Identify malicious PyPI and npm packages

items.description: An npm library of string validators and sanitizers.

items.description: Static analysis for GitHub Actions and CI/CD workflows.

items.description: Detect security flaws in Joi validation schemas.

items.description: drop-in replacement with prototype poisoning protection.
